visual_concept: One‑way CDC stream separating OLTP row store from OLAP column store to avoid performance contention.
image_prompt: Flat 2D orthographic diagram, deep navy background (#050B14). White cylinders: left side representing OLTP row store, right side representing OLAP column store, a small white node between them representing CDC. Thin cool‑grey infrastructure lines connect them. A bright cyan arrow flows one‑way from the OLTP cylinder through the CDC node to the OLAP cylinder, illustrating data capture and transformation. No text, clean developer‑tool aesthetic, high negative space, centered composition.
negative_prompt: text, labels, numbers, code snippets, UI screenshots, excessive glow, cyberpunk, 3D renders, realistic textures, photorealistic people, rainbow colors, floating icons without system relationships, duplicate nodes, arbitrary arrows, decorative elements, generic corporate stock graphics
accessibility_alt_text: Diagram shows a left‑side OLTP row store cylinder, a right‑side OLAP column store cylinder, and a bright cyan arrow flowing one‑way from the OLTP cylinder through a CDC node to the OLAP cylinder, illustrating a one‑way data stream that keeps transactional and analytical workloads separate.
